politicianName: DY, FAUSTINO MICHAEL CARLOS III T.
summary: Isabela 5th District representative with 132 principal-authored bills. Only an anti-dynasty ban and the national minimum wage surfaced under rubric topics. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
